air_speed_trim.help_en: Air speed trim speeds up or slows down the fan by this multiplier. It enables you to adjust for different batch sizes, bean densities, etc, without the need to transform the fan profile curve.
air_speed_trim.help: 空气速度调整通过乘数来加速或减慢风扇速度。它使您能够根据不同的批次大小、豆密度等进行调整，而无需转换风扇曲线图。
air_speed_trim.label: 空气速度调整

altitude_trim.help_en: Altitude trim adjusts the fan to compensate for roasting at altitude. Use the Link App to look up the number to use for your altitude. This number is a fan speed multiplier.
altitude_trim.help: 海拔调整可调节风扇以补偿高海拔烘焙。使用Link应用程序查找适合您的海拔的数字。此数字是风扇速度乘数。
altitude_trim.label: 海拔调整

ambient_cutoff_difference.help_en: part of the roaster preferences: if reference and probe are further apart than this then probe is not to be treated as ambient
ambient_cutoff_difference.help: 烘焙机偏好的一部分：如果参考点和探针之间的距离大于这个，那么探针将不被视为环境
ambient_cutoff_difference.label: 环境截止差

ambient_cutoff_probe.help_en: part of the roaster preferences: probe temperatures above this are not to be treated as ambient
ambient_cutoff_probe.help: 烘焙机偏好的一部分：高于此温度的探针温度不被视为环境温度
ambient_cutoff_probe.label: 环境截止探头

ambient_cutoff_reference.help_en: part of the roaster preferences: reference temperatures above this are not to be treated as ambient
ambient_cutoff_reference.help: 烘焙机偏好的一部分：高于此温度的参考温度不被视为环境温度
ambient_cutoff_reference.label: 环境截止参考

ambient_default_temperature.help_en: part of the roaster preferences: if ambient temperature cannot be determined, this value is used as ambient
ambient_default_temperature.help: 烘焙机偏好的一部分：如果无法确定环境温度，该值将用作环境温度
ambient_default_temperature.label: 环境默认温度

ambient_temperature.help_en: The ambient room temperature. This value is normally calculated by the roaster using probe data, but it can also be entered by the user (for firmware v 7.5.0+).
ambient_temperature.help: 环境室温。此值通常由烘焙机使用探针数据计算得出，但也可以由用户输入（适用于固件版本7.5.0+）。
ambient_temperature.label: 环境温度

back2back_count.help_en: It is recommended that if carrying out multiple roasts in a single session the roaster be left turned on. This is to allow the ambient temperature calculation to be performed correctly. This number indicates the total number of roasts that have been done since the roaster was last turned on.
back2back_count.help: 如果在一个烘焙过程中进行多次烘焙，建议保持烘焙机处于开启状态。这样可以正确计算环境温度。此数字表示自上次开启烘焙机以来已完成的烘焙总次数。
back2back_count.label: 连续计数

boost_load_fan_multiplier.help_en: Speeds up or slows down the fan by this multiplier. It adjusts for different load sizes. Calculated from boost load size. (Default 1.0 at load size 120g)
boost_load_fan_multiplier.help: 以此乘数加速或减慢风扇速度。它根据不同的负载大小调节。根据载量增量计算。（负载大小为120g时默认值为1.0）
boost_load_fan_multiplier.label: 风扇增量乘数

boost_load_power_multiplier.help_en: Preheat power is modified by this multiplier. It adjusts for different load sizes. Calculated from boost load size. (Default 1.0 at load size 120g)
boost_load_power_multiplier.help: 预热功率由此乘数修改。它根据不同的负载大小进行调整。根据载量增量计算。（负载大小为120g时默认值为1.0）
boost_load_power_multiplier.label: 功率增量乘数

boost_load_size.help_en: The selected load size. This value is present if the 'BOOST' feature is enabled. (Default 120g)
boost_load_size.help: 选定负载大小。如果启用了“增量”功能，则显示此值。（默认120g）
boost_load_size.label: 载量增量

calibration_data.help_en:
If roasting is uneven, fan speed calibration (aka bean circulation calibration) might need to be adjusted. See this Wiki article.

v (supply voltage multiplier) and ohm (element Ohms multiplier) are factory set and should not be adjusted.

(If the calibration data is shown here as four numbers, they are supply voltage multiplier, fan speed, cooling speed, and element Ohms multiplier.)

Calibration can be changed only in calibration mode (turn roaster on with both - and + buttons held down).
calibration_data.help:
如果烘焙不均匀，可能需要调节风扇速度校准（又称豆循环校准）。请参阅此维基百科文章。

v（电源电压乘数）和ohm（元件欧姆乘数）为出厂设置，不应调节。

（如果校准数据在此处显示为四个数字，则它们是电源电压乘数、风扇速度、冷却速度和元件欧姆乘数。）

只能在校准模式下更改校准（打开烘焙机并按下 - 和 + 按钮）。
calibration_data.label: 校准数据

colour_change.help_en: The colour change event (aka dry end) as recorded by the operator during the roast.
colour_change.help: 操作员在烘焙过程中记录的转黄事件（又称脱水结束结束）。
colour_change.label: 转黄

cooldown_end_ror_1st.help_en: part of the roaster preferences: cool down ends at this ROR if this is the first roast after power on
cooldown_end_ror_1st.help: 烘焙机偏好的一部分：如果这是通电后的第一次烘焙，则冷却在此ROR结束
cooldown_end_ror_1st.label: 冷却结束ror第1次

cooldown_end_ror_b2b.help_en: part of the roaster preferences: cool down ends at this ROR if this is a back-to-back roast after power on
cooldown_end_ror_b2b.help: 烘焙机偏好的一部分：如果这是通电后连续烘焙，则冷却在此ROR结束
cooldown_end_ror_b2b.label: 冷却结束ror连续

cooldown_end_temperature.help_en: part of the roaster preferences: cool down ends at this probe temperature if roast did not complete, e.g. for an empty test roast
cooldown_end_temperature.help: 烘焙机偏好的一部分：如果烘焙未完成，则在此探针温度下冷却结束，例如对于空测试烘焙
cooldown_end_temperature.label: 冷却结束温度

cooldown_hi_speed.help_en:
high speed at start of cooldown to quench roast fast

Reducing this value is sometimes done to reduce the amount of beans in the chaff for dark roasts. Beans are of lower density in darker roasts and more likely to get into the chaff.
cooldown_hi_speed.help:
冷却开始时高速以快速淬火

有时降低此值是为了减少深烘烘焙豆壳中的豆数量。深烘烘焙的豆密度较低，更容易进入豆壳中。
cooldown_hi_speed.label: 冷却高速

cooldown_lo_speed.help_en:
low speed to use after the initial cooling is complete

This allows a quieter cooldown after the initial fast quench at high speed.
cooldown_lo_speed.help:
初始冷却完成后使用低速

这允许在高速初始快速淬火后更安静地冷却。
cooldown_lo_speed.label: 冷却低速

cooldown_lo_temperature.help_en: temperature at which cooldown changes to low speed
cooldown_lo_temperature.label: 冷却至温度

cooldown_slow_time.help_en: part of the roaster preferences: fan speed starts dropping after this many seconds of cool down
cooldown_slow_time.help: 烘焙机偏好的一部分：经过这么多秒的冷却后，风扇速度开始下降
cooldown_slow_time.label: 冷却减缓时间

corner1_time_end.help_en: At this time the roast control system will go back to using the current gradient as the target gradient. Recommended time is a few seconds after the sharp corner.  <nucleus> Corner 1 ends at a time relative to first crack if relative zones are turned on in the roaster preferences.</nucleus>
corner1_time_end.help: 此时，烘焙控制系统将恢复使用当前梯度作为目标梯度。建议时间是在尖角之后的几秒钟。
corner1_time_end.label: 角1时间结束

corner1_time_start.help_en: At this time the roast control system will start using the gradient from the corner end time (corner1 time end) as the target gradient. Recommend start is approx 15 secs before the sharp corner. <nucleus> Corner 1 starts at a time relative to first crack if relative zones are turned on in the roaster preferences.</nucleus>
corner1_time_start.help: 此时，烘焙控制系统将开始使用从角结束时间（角1时间结束）开始的梯度作为目标梯度。建议在尖角前约15秒开始。
corner1_time_start.label: 角1时间开始

density_factor.help_en: This is a fan speed multiplier that compensates for changes in air density caused by ambient temperature differences.
density_factor.help: 这是一个风扇速度乘数，可补偿因环境温度差引起的空气密度变化。
density_factor.label: 密度因数

development_percent.help_en: The percentage of the roast that took place after first crack. Also known as DTR.
development_percent.help: 一爆后发生的烘焙百分比。也称为发展时间比。
development_percent.label: 发展阶段百分比

roast_end_by_time_ratio.help_en:
The end point of a roast is shown as a red square ■ on the roast profile curve.

The way the red square works is different depending on the Preferences-Priority setting on the roaster.

When "Preferences-Priority +DTR" is selected the roast will always end by time. This ensures the DTR percentage is correctly applied. The roast will end when the elapsed time matches the red square's time. The roast end by time ratio is ignored. This is the recommended Priority setting for the Link system.

When "Preferences-Priority -Level" is selected the roast will end by threshold line. If the actual temperature does not follow the profile curve, the roast will end when the temperature curve crosses the threshold line defined by roast end by time ratio (faint red dotted line). Check the box labelled 'Grid' to see the threshold line.

The slope of the threshold line is defined by roast end by time ratio.

  • 1.0 means roast ends at that time regardless of temperature. The threshold line is vertical.
  • 0.0 means roast ends at that temperature regardless of the time. The threshold line is horizontal.
  • Numbers between 0 and 1 set the threshold line at different angles.

This allows you to make adjustments so that when a roast does not follow the line it should still finish after approx the same amount of development. Usually we recommend numbers around 0.75, but you can adjust it to suit your tastes, profile, and green beans.

Note: If you are designing profiles for others to use, make sure roast end by time ratio is set to an appropriate value. You might be using Priority +DTR, but the user of your profile might use Priority -Level on their roaster.
roast_end_by_time_ratio.help:
烘焙的终点在烘焙曲线图上显示为红色方块■。

红色方块的工作方式因烘焙机上的“首选项-优先级”设置而异。

选择“首选项-优先级 + 发展时间比”时，烘焙将始终按时间结束。这可确保正确应用发展时间比百分比。当经过的时间与红色方块的时间匹配时，烘焙将结束。烘焙结束时间比例将被忽略。

选择“首选项-优先级 - 等级”时，烘焙将按阈值线结束。如果实际温度不遵循曲线曲线，则当温度曲线穿过由烘焙结束时间比例（淡红色虚线）定义的阈值线时，烘焙将结束。选中标有“网格”的框以查看阈值线。

阈值线的斜率由烘焙结束时间比例定义。

  • 1.0表示无论温度如何，烘焙在该时间结束。阈值线是垂直的。
  • 0.0 表示无论时间如何，烘焙在该温度下结束。阈值线是水平的。
  • 0到1之间的数字将阈值线设置为不同的角度。

这样您就可以进行调整，以便当烘焙不遵循线条时，它仍将在大约相同的发展阶段数后结束。通常我们建议的数字在0.75左右，但您可以根据自己的口味、曲线和生豆进行调整。

注意：如果您在设计供他人使用的曲线，请确保将烘焙结束时间比例设置为适当的值。您可能正在使用首选项 + 发展时间比，但您的曲线的用户可能在其烘焙机上使用首选项 - 等级。
roast_end_by_time_ratio.label: 烘焙结束时间比例

roast_levels.help_en:
This is a series of temperatures that define the thresholds for the roast levels. The first is the temperature for level 0, the next is the temperature for level 1, the next is the temperature for level 2, and so on. The decimal levels (0.1, 0.2, etc) are spread out equally across the interval to the next temperature.

You can manipulate these numbers so that actual roast darkness matches the name associated with each number (light, medium, etc) for the particular profile you are developing.
roast_levels.help:
这是一系列定义烘焙程度阈值的温度。第一个是等级0的温度，下一个是等级1的温度，下一个是等级2的温度，依此类推。小数等级（0.1、0.2等）均匀分布在下一个温度的间隔内。

您可以操纵这些数字，使实际烘焙深度与您正在开发的特定曲线的每个数字关联的名称（浅烘、中烘等）相匹配。

roast_min_desired_rate_of_rise.help_en:
This acts as an anti-stall setting. If the bean temperature races ahead of the profile curve this setting acts to prevent the control system stalling the roast in an attempt to get back onto the curve. The minimum rate of rise will be applied until eventually the roast gets back onto the curve.

This number should always be smaller than the profile curve rate of rise, because the minimum rate of rise will be applied regardless. If it is too large it will prevent the system from following the profile curve.
roast_min_desired_rate_of_rise.help:

此数字应始终小于曲线图升温速率，因为无论如何都将应用最小升温速率。如果它太大，它将阻止系统遵循曲线图。

zone1_boost.help_en:
The number of °/min added to the desired ROR while in the zone. Use a negative number to decrease the desired ROR. This is used to help keep the roast temperature following the profile curve at times when exothermic or endothermic changes are pushing it away. If the temperature tends to go below the line use a positive boost; if it goes above the line use a negative boost.

Expert level only: Create a 'power profiling zone' by setting both multipliers to zero. This disables the PID control system within the zone and the roaster will not respond to temperature changes at the bean probe. Power during such a zone is controlled by the boost, which defines the percent increase in power within this zone. The power increase takes place regardless of the temperature at the bean probe. PID control resumes at the end of the zone. A 'power profiling zone' can be used to flatten out parts of the roast where a sequence of exothermic and endothermic changes cause the control system to over-react with excessive swings in power and ROR.
zone1_boost.help:
在区域中时添加到期望ROR的°C/分数值。使用负数可减小期望ROR。这用于帮助在放热或吸热变化将其推开时保持烘焙温度遵循曲线图。如果温度趋于低于该线，则使用正增量；如果温度高于该线，则使用负增量。

红色方块的工作方式因烘焙机上的“首选项-优先级”设置而异。

选择“首选项-优先级 + 发展时间比”时，烘焙将始终按时间结束。这可确保正确应用发展时间比百分比。当经过的时间与红色方块的时间匹配时，烘焙将结束。烘焙结束时间比例将被忽略。这是Link系统的推荐优先级设置。

选择“首选项-优先级 - 等级”时，烘焙将按阈值线结束。如果实际温度不遵循曲线曲线，则当温度曲线穿过由烘焙结束时间比例（淡红色虚线）定义的阈值线时，烘焙将结束。选中标有“网格”的框以查看阈值线。

阈值线的斜率由烘焙结束时间比例定义。

  • 1.0表示无论温度如何，烘焙在该时间结束。阈值线是垂直的。
  • 0.0 表示无论时间如何，烘焙在该温度下结束。阈值线是水平的。
  • 0到1之间的数字将阈值线设置为不同的角度。

这样您就可以进行调整，以便当烘焙不遵循线条时，它仍将在大约相同的发展阶段数后结束。通常我们建议的数字在0.75左右，但您可以根据自己的口味、曲线和生豆进行调整。
